about: TAI minus UTC in whole seconds from each date (UTC, Unix milliseconds) since J2000.0, as IERS Bulletin C states them; TT is TAI + 32.184 s. The Sol door reads the device's clock (UTC) onto the universe clock (TT) with it. A leap second announced after this list was made is missing until the list is updated: the drawn sky is then a second early per missing leap.
source: IERS Earth Orientation Center, Bulletin C (Paris Observatory), leap seconds of 1 January 2006, 1 January 2009, 1 July 2012, 1 July 2015 and 1 January 2017; Bulletin C 70 (July 2025) announces no leap second before July 2026. Unverified against Bulletin C itself (figures from memory, 26 Nov 2026).
